decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the construction of basement and rear extension to provide habitable rooms incorporating 2 lightwells, and the erection of boundary walls to the existing house, as shown on drawing numbers, PS01.01 and PS01.11 received 19 December 2005, is recommended for approval as the proposed development would not harm the appearance of the existing building or appearance of the existing street scene and would satisfactorily maintain the setting of the adjoining conservation area and the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The extension (building) hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as North Lodge, Chiswick Village, Chiswick, London W4 3DE.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until full details of the grass roof of the extension have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details to be submitted shall include drawings and a written specification of cultivation and other operations associated with plant establishment, schedules of plants with species, plant sizes, proposed numbers/ densities, drainage and implementation and long term maintenance programmes.

Condition : 7 - With respect to any condition that requires the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, the works thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with that approval unless subsequently otherwise approved in writing of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Construction of a basement and rear extension to provide habitable rooms incorporating 2 lightwells, erection of boundary walls to existing house.
